## 1) Packages

## 2) Inputs

```{r inputs}
run_root <- "D:/Codex/Test/downloaded_results/server_json_runs"
n_runs <- 10L
seed_start <- 2026L

run_tbl <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  method = c("raw", "bhzip"),
  run = seq_len(n_runs)
) %>%
  mutate(
    seed = seed_start + run - 1L,
    dset = sprintf("oocyte_zygote_%s_pairs_r%02d", method, run),
    h5ad = file.path(run_root, dset, "1M", "innerproduct", "anndata_obj.h5ad"),
    exists = file.exists(h5ad)
  )

if (any(!run_tbl$exists)) {
  print(run_tbl %>% filter(!exists))
  stop("Missing one or more anndata_obj.h5ad files.")
}
```

## 3) Helpers (Read h5ad + Clustering + Metrics)

```{r helpers}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

read_h5ad_csr <- function(g) {
  data <- as.numeric(g[["data"]]$read())
  indices <- as.integer(g[["indices"]]$read()) + 1L
  indptr <- as.integer(g[["indptr"]]$read())
  shape <- as.integer(g[["shape"]]$read())
  n_row <- shape[1]
  n_col <- shape[2]
  i <- rep(seq_len(n_row), diff(indptr))
  Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = i, j = indices, x = data, dims = c(n_row, n_col))
}

read_h5ad_matrix <- function(node) {
  if (inherits(node, "H5D")) {
    x <- node$read()
    return(as.matrix(x))
  }
  if (inherits(node, "H5Group")) {
    nms <- names(node)
    if (all(c("data", "indices", "indptr", "shape") %in% nms)) {
      return(as.matrix(read_h5ad_csr(node)))
    }
  }
  stop("Unsupported matrix encoding in h5ad.")
}

read_h5ad_obs_col <- function(obs_group, key) {
  node <- obs_group[[key]]

  if (inherits(node, "H5Group")) {
    nms <- names(node)
    if (all(c("codes", "categories") %in% nms)) {
      codes <- as.integer(node[["codes"]]$read())
      categories <- as.character(node[["categories"]]$read())
      return(as.vector(categories[codes + 1L]))
    }
  }

  if (inherits(node, "H5D")) {
    vals <- node$read()
    attrs <- tryCatch(hdf5r::h5attr_names(node), error = function(e) character(0))
    if ("categories" %in% attrs) {
      cats_obj <- hdf5r::h5attr(node, "categories")
      categories <- as.character(cats_obj$dereference()[[1]]$read())
      return(as.vector(categories[as.integer(vals) + 1L]))
    }
    return(as.vector(as.character(vals)))
  }

  stop("Unsupported obs encoding for key: ", key)
}

read_h5ad_run <- function(path) {
  h5 <- hdf5r::H5File$new(path, mode = "r")
  on.exit(try(h5$close_all(), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  X <- read_h5ad_matrix(h5[["X"]])
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  storage.mode(X) <- "double"

  X_pca <- NULL
  if ("obsm" %in% names(h5) && "X_pca" %in% names(h5[["obsm"]])) {
    X_pca <- read_h5ad_matrix(h5[["obsm"]][["X_pca"]])
    X_pca <- as.matrix(X_pca)
    storage.mode(X_pca) <- "double"
  }
  y <- factor(as.vector(read_h5ad_obs_col(h5[["obs"]], "celltype")))

  list(X = X, X_pca = X_pca, y = y)
}

cosine_dist <- function(z) {
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  nrm <- sqrt(rowSums(z^2))
  nrm[nrm == 0] <- 1
  zn <- z / nrm
  sim <- tcrossprod(zn)
  sim[sim > 1] <- 1
  sim[sim < -1] <- -1
  as.dist(1 - sim)
}

silhouette_cosine <- function(z, labels) {
  labs <- as.integer(factor(labels))
  if (length(unique(labs)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  s <- cluster::silhouette(labs, dist = cosine_dist(z))
  mean(s[, "sil_width"], na.rm = TRUE)
}

ensure_min_2d <- function(z) {
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  if (ncol(z) >= 2) return(z)
  cbind(z, rep(0, nrow(z)))
}

safe_gmm_labels <- function(z, n_clusters, seed) {
  z2 <- ensure_min_2d(z)
  set.seed(seed)
  fit <- tryCatch(
    mclust::Mclust(z2, G = n_clusters, verbose = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(fit) && !is.null(fit$classification)) {
    return(as.integer(fit$classification))
  }
  # Fallback to kmeans labels if GMM fails on edge-case geometry.
  as.integer(kmeans(z2, centers = n_clusters, nstart = 10, iter.max = 100)$cluster)
}

compute_space_metrics <- function(z, y, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  z <- as.matrix(z)
  storage.mode(z) <- "double"
  y <- factor(as.vector(y))
  if (nrow(z) < 3) stop("Need at least 3 cells for clustering metrics.")
  if (length(y) != nrow(z)) stop("Label length does not match number of rows in matrix.")
  n_clusters <- length(unique(y))

  pred_kmeans <- kmeans(z, centers = n_clusters, nstart = 10, iter.max = 100)$cluster
  pred_agglom <- cutree(hclust(dist(z), method = "ward.D2"), k = n_clusters)
  pred_gmm <- safe_gmm_labels(z, n_clusters, seed)

  pred_map <- list(
    "k-means" = pred_kmeans,
    "agglomerative" = pred_agglom,
    "gmm" = pred_gmm
  )

  out <- list()
  for (alg in names(pred_map)) {
    p <- pred_map[[alg]]
    if (all(is.na(p))) {
      out[[paste0("ari_", alg)]] <- NA_real_
      out[[paste0("nmi_", alg)]] <- NA_real_
      out[[paste0("silhouette_", alg)]] <- NA_real_
    } else {
      out[[paste0("ari_", alg)]] <- mclust::adjustedRandIndex(y, p)
      out[[paste0("nmi_", alg)]] <- aricode::NMI(as.integer(y), as.integer(p))
      out[[paste0("silhouette_", alg)]] <- silhouette_cosine(z, p)
    }
  }

  ari_vals <- unlist(out[grep("^ari_", names(out))], use.names = FALSE)
  nmi_vals <- unlist(out[grep("^nmi_", names(out))], use.names = FALSE)
  sil_vals <- unlist(out[grep("^silhouette_", names(out))], use.names = FALSE)

  out$best_ari <- ifelse(all(is.na(ari_vals)), NA_real_, max(ari_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
  out$best_nmi <- ifelse(all(is.na(nmi_vals)), NA_real_, max(nmi_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
  out$best_silhouette <- ifelse(all(is.na(sil_vals)), NA_real_, max(sil_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
  out$avgBio <- mean(c(out$best_ari, out$best_nmi, out$best_silhouette), na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble::as_tibble(out)
}
```

## 4) Compute Metrics (Embedding32 vs SCORE_PCA2D)

```{r compute}
first_row <- run_tbl[1, ]
first_dat <- read_h5ad_run(first_row$h5ad)
cat("Smoke check first run:\n")
cat("X dim:", paste(dim(first_dat$X), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("X_pca dim:", if (is.null(first_dat$X_pca)) "NULL" else paste(dim(first_dat$X_pca), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("y length:", length(first_dat$y), "n levels:", length(levels(first_dat$y)), "\n")

compute_one_run <- function(method, run, seed, h5ad) {
  dat <- read_h5ad_run(h5ad)
  y <- dat$y
  
  orient_rows_cells <- function(mat, y, label) {
    if (is.null(mat)) return(NULL)
    if (nrow(mat) == length(y)) return(mat)
    if (ncol(mat) == length(y)) return(t(mat))
    stop(sprintf(
      "%s shape mismatch: matrix is %d x %d, but labels length is %d",
      label, nrow(mat), ncol(mat), length(y)
    ))
  }

  x <- orient_rows_cells(dat$X, y, "X")

  # Match SCORE PCA as closely as possible in R:
  # SCORE uses Scanpy PCA on embedding then plots first 2 PCs.
  z_pca <- if (!is.null(dat$X_pca)) {
    x_pca_oriented <- orient_rows_cells(dat$X_pca, y, "X_pca")
    x_pca_oriented[, seq_len(min(2L, ncol(x_pca_oriented))), drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    stats::prcomp(x, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  }
  z_pca <- ensure_min_2d(z_pca)

  m_emb <- compute_space_metrics(x, y, seed) %>%
    mutate(space = "Embedding32")
  m_pca <- compute_space_metrics(z_pca, y, seed) %>%
    mutate(space = "SCORE_PCA2D")

  bind_rows(m_emb, m_pca) %>%
    mutate(method = method, run = run, seed = seed) %>%
    relocate(method, run, seed, space)
}

results_df <- pmap_dfr(
  list(run_tbl$method, run_tbl$run, run_tbl$seed, run_tbl$h5ad),
  compute_one_run
)

long_df <- results_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(method, run, seed, space),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = c("raw", "bhzip"), labels = c("raw", "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)")),
    space = factor(space, levels = c("Embedding32", "SCORE_PCA2D"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    option4 = factor(
      paste(space, method, sep = " | "),
      levels = c(
        "Embedding32 | raw",
        "Embedding32 | HiCBZIP-GB(NB)",
        "SCORE_PCA2D | raw",
        "SCORE_PCA2D | HiCBZIP-GB(NB)"
      )
    )
  )
```

## 5) Summary (Same Metric Scope as extract_paper...)

```{r summary}
metric_order <- c(
  # ARI
  "ari_agglomerative", "ari_gmm", "ari_k-means", "best_ari",
  # NMI
  "nmi_agglomerative", "nmi_gmm", "nmi_k-means", "best_nmi",
  # Silhouette
  "silhouette_agglomerative", "silhouette_gmm", "silhouette_k-means", "best_silhouette",
  # AvgBIO
  "avgBio"
)

plot_df <- long_df %>%
  filter(metric %in% metric_order) %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_order))

summary_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(space, method, metric) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(metric, space, method)

summary_fmt <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(mean_sd = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean, sd)) %>%
  select(space, method, metric, mean_sd, n)

print(summary_fmt, n = 200)
```

## 6) Boxplot: 4 Options Side-by-Side, Facet = Metric

```{r plot_space, fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
p_space <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = option4, y = value, fill = option4, color = option4)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.68,
    alpha = 0.30,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.78)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 1.2,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.10)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Embedding32 | raw" = "#4E79A7",
    "Embedding32 | HiCBZIP-GB(NB)" = "#E15759",
    "SCORE_PCA2D | raw" = "#59A14F",
    "SCORE_PCA2D | HiCBZIP-GB(NB)" = "#F28E2B"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Embedding32 | raw" = "#2F5D8A",
    "Embedding32 | HiCBZIP-GB(NB)" = "#B63D40",
    "SCORE_PCA2D | raw" = "#3E7F39",
    "SCORE_PCA2D | HiCBZIP-GB(NB)" = "#BF6E1C"
  )) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Server InnerProduct: Raw vs HiCBZIP-GB(NB)",
    subtitle = "Four options side-by-side (Embedding32/PCA2D x Raw/HiCBZIP-GB(NB))",
    x = "Option",
    y = "Metric Value",
    fill = "Option",
    color = "Option"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_space)
```

## 7) Grouped Plot (Same Style as extract_paper...)

```{r grouped_plot, fig.width=16, fig.height=9}
group_boundaries <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = levels(plot_df$metric),
  idx = seq_along(levels(plot_df$metric)),
  metric_group = dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^ari|best_ari$", metric, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ARI",
    grepl("^nmi|best_nmi$", metric, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "NMI",
    grepl("^silhouette|best_silhouette$", metric, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Silhouette",
    metric == "avgBio" ~ "AvgBIO",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
)

separator_x <- group_boundaries %>%
  group_by(metric_group) %>%
  summarise(last_idx = max(idx), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(last_idx)

if (nrow(separator_x) > 1) {
  separator_x <- separator_x$last_idx[seq_len(nrow(separator_x) - 1)] + 0.5
} else {
  separator_x <- numeric(0)
}

label_x <- group_boundaries %>%
  group_by(metric_group) %>%
  summarise(x = mean(idx), .groups = "drop")

ylab <- 1

p_group <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = metric, y = value, fill = option4, color = option4)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.68,
    alpha = 0.30,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.88)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 1.2,
    position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.88, jitter.width = 0.10)
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = separator_x,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_x,
    aes(x = x, y = ylab, label = metric_group),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.2,
    vjust = -0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Embedding32 | raw" = "#4E79A7",
    "Embedding32 | HiCBZIP-GB(NB)" = "#E15759",
    "SCORE_PCA2D | raw" = "#59A14F",
    "SCORE_PCA2D | HiCBZIP-GB(NB)" = "#F28E2B"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Embedding32 | raw" = "#2F5D8A",
    "Embedding32 | HiCBZIP-GB(NB)" = "#B63D40",
    "SCORE_PCA2D | raw" = "#3E7F39",
    "SCORE_PCA2D | HiCBZIP-GB(NB)" = "#BF6E1C"
  )) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Server InnerProduct Metrics by Group",
    subtitle = "Four options shown side-by-side per metric; y fixed to 0-1",
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Option",
    color = "Option"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 35, 10)
  )

print(p_group)
```
